text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, valproic acid inventory across the health system provides 13 to 18 days on hand. Corvale East holds 84 units at 6.6 units per day (13 days). Corvale General holds 140 units at 7.9 units per day (18 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 29 units at 2.1 units per day (14 days). The current supply (NDC 00904762070) labels PHARM ASSOC as the manufacturing plant under Major Pharmaceuticals.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list valproic acid as in shortage as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current stock is limited but not critical. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Alternative suppliers are available but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants, preventing supply chain risk assessment.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer evaluates and qualifies ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. product; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer evaluates and qualifies American Health Packaging product; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Bryant Ranch Prepack product; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Chartwell Governmental & Specialty RX, LLC product; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Chartwell RX, LLC product; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
